subject: Startups
title: Regulatory Sandboxes
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Regulatory Sandboxes.

hook.text: The UK created a 'regulatory sandbox' where fintech startups can test products with real users under relaxed rules.

buildup.text: Sandboxes let startups experiment with innovative products without needing full regulatory compliance from day one.

discovery.text: Over 50 countries now have regulatory sandboxes. Singapore, Australia, and Abu Dhabi are leading adopters.

twist.text: Graduating from a sandbox to full compliance is still hard.

climax.text: Sandboxes signal that governments want innovation AND safety. They're a bridge between creativity and responsibility.

punchline.text: Sandboxes give startups room to innovate under a safety net.

quiz.question: What is a regulatory sandbox?
options: A children's playground at tech companies
A framework where startups can test products under relaxed rules
A type of software testing environment
